# noust_database (Resource)

A database on one of the server's running engines, created with an owner account of its own. It belongs to the application, or the team, project and environment, you name.

**A database holds data.** Every attribute the server only takes when the database is made replaces it when changed, which drops the data: put `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }` on production databases, or set `deletion_protection`. Destroying a database dumps it first by default (`dump_before_destroy`), and that dump is the server's last one.

Needs the permission `databases.write` to create and `databases.manage` with sudo mode to drop. The connection string is not an attribute: an application created with `app` set receives it in its environment, marked secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A PostgreSQL database for the application. Its connection string reaches the application's environment,
# marked secret, and is not an attribute here.
resource "noust_database" "api" {
  name   = "api_production"
  engine = "postgresql"
  app    = noust_application.api.domain

  # Data is not dropped by accident.
  deletion_protection = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `engine` (String) The engine: `postgresql`, `mysql`, `mongodb`... as `GET /api/databases/engines` names it. Changing it replaces the database.
- `name` (String) The database's name. Changing it replaces the database.

### Optional

- `app` (String) The domain of the application the database belongs to. Left out, the database is not linked to one, and one linked outside Terraform is kept. Changing it replaces the database.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Refuse to destroy the database from Terraform until this is set to `false` and applied. Default `false`.
- `disconnect_clients_on_destroy` (Boolean) Disconnect open sessions before dropping the database. Default `false`.
- `dump_before_destroy` (Boolean) Dump the database before dropping it, so the data can be restored. Default `true`.
- `encoding` (String) The character encoding. The engine's default when omitted. Changing it replaces the database.
- `environment` (String) The environment the database belongs to. Changing it replaces the database.
- `owner` (String) The account that owns the database. Made by the server when omitted. Changing it replaces the database.
- `project` (String) The project the database belongs to. Changing it replaces the database.
- `team` (String) The team that owns a database with no application. Changing it replaces the database.
- `unlink_apps_on_destroy` (Boolean) Remove the database's variables from the applications that use it when it is dropped. Default `true` when `app` is set, since they are the variables this database made for it, and `false` otherwise: the server refuses to drop a database an application uses.

### Read-Only

- `engine_version` (String) The version of the engine the database runs on.
- `id` (String) The engine and the name, joined with a slash: `engine/name`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The engine and the name, joined with a slash.
terraform import noust_database.api postgresql/api_production
```
